symptoms.question: When you try to start the car, does the engine crank or turn over? (yes/no)
When the ignition is on, are the dashboard lights bright and normal? (yes/no)
Is the battery/charging system warning light on while driving? (yes/no)
Is the check engine warning light on while driving? (yes/no)
Does the check engine light flash while driving (not just stay on)? (yes/no)
Does the engine sometimes stall or cut out while idling? (yes/no)
Does the engine run rough or uneven when idling? (yes/no)
Is the car especially hard to start when the engine is cold? (yes/no)
Do you sometimes smell fuel around the engine bay? (yes/no)

rules.diagnosis: Likely battery or battery connection problem.
rules.advice: Do not attempt to keep starting the car. Check battery terminals and call roadside assistance or a garage.

rules.diagnosis: Possible starter motor or ignition circuit issue.
rules.advice: The electrical system appears to have power but the engine does not crank. It is safer to have the car inspected by a mechanic.

rules.diagnosis: Possible alternator or charging system problem.
rules.advice: A battery warning light while driving often indicates that the alternator is not charging correctly. Limit driving and have the charging system checked soon.

rules.diagnosis: Engine control system has detected a fault.
rules.advice: The car may still be drivable, but avoid hard acceleration and have the fault code read at a garage as soon as possible.

rules.diagnosis: Engine runs rough at idle, possibly due to mixture or ignition issues.
rules.advice: Avoid high engine loads and have the engine checked for stored fault codes and basic maintenance.

rules.diagnosis: Battery may be weak, especially at low temperatures.
rules.advice: A weak battery can struggle in cold weather. Consider having the battery tested and replaced if necessary.

rules.diagnosis: Smell of fuel near the engine bay suggests a possible fuel leak.
rules.advice: Do not ignore fuel smells in the engine bay. Avoid driving long distances and have the fuel system inspected soon.
